```{r}
meta.t <- t.cells@meta.data

meta.t$celltype.specific.simple <- ifelse(meta.t$celltype.malig == "malig", "CTCL", "Benign_T")

meta.t$orig.merge <- ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% c("S72", "S73"), "S72",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% c("S74", "S75"), "S74",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 153:156), "S153",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 157:161), "S157",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 162:165), "S162",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 166:169), "S166",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 170:175), "S170",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 176:181), "S176",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 182:187), "S182",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 188:192), "S188",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 216:223), "S216",
                      ifelse(meta.t$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 225:232), "S225",
                      meta.t$orig.ident))))))))))))

meta.t$orig.merge.malig <- paste0(meta.t$orig.merge, "_", meta.t$celltype.specific.simple)

t.cells@meta.data <- meta.t

table(t.cells$celltype.specific.simple)
table(t.cells$orig.merge.malig)

ctcl.pts <- sort(unique(meta.t$orig.merge[meta.t$Dx.simple == "CTCL"]))
```


```{r}
df.ctcl.deg <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.merge, t.cells$celltype.specific.simple))

df.ctcl.deg.ss <- subset(df.ctcl.deg, CTCL > 50 & Benign_T > 50)

query <- rownames(df.ctcl.deg.ss)
```




```{r}
t.query <- subset(t.cells, orig.merge %in% query)

t.query.ss <- t.query
DefaultAssay(t.query.ss) <- "RNA"
t.query.ss@assays$sketch <- NULL
t.query.ss <- JoinLayers(t.query.ss)

t.query.ss <- r2sample_seurat(t.query.ss, group_var = "orig.merge.malig", n = 1000, barcode_column = "barcode.unique")

split.t <- SplitObject(object = t.query.ss, split.by = "orig.merge")

markers.split.t <- list()

markers.split.t <- lapply(names(split.t), FUN = function(sample_name) {
  # Get the current sample
  x <- split.t[[sample_name]]
  
  # Set identities to "final.clones"
  Idents(x) <- x$celltype.specific.simple
  
  markers.x <- FindMarkers(
    x,
    ident.1 = "CTCL",
    ident.2 = "Benign_T") # Cluster of interest

  # Add the sample name to the results
  markers.x$sample <- sample_name
  markers.x$gene <- rownames(markers.x)
  markers.x$dif <- markers.x$pct.1 - markers.x$pct.2
  markers.x$log_padj <- -log10(markers.x$p_val_adj + 1e-300)
  
  # Return the significant markers with the sample name
  return(markers.x)
})

names(markers.split.t) <- names(split.t)
saveRDS(markers.split.t, "~/hpchome/ctcl.deg.split.t.rds")

```

```{r}
df.markers.matrix.all <- data.frame("Sum" = rowSums(markers.matrix.ss.scale, na.rm = T), 
                                    "Count" = rowSums(!is.na(markers.matrix.ss.scale)),
                                    "Abs" = rowSums(abs(markers.matrix.ss.scale), na.rm = T),
                                    "Var" = rowVars(markers.matrix.ss.scale, na.rm = T))
df.markers.matrix.all$Norm <- df.markers.matrix.all$Sum / df.markers.matrix.all$Count

df.markers.matrix.all <- arrange(df.markers.matrix.all, desc(Sum))

plot(df.markers.matrix.all$Sum, df.markers.matrix.all$Abs)
```

meta <- t.query.ss@meta.data

  as.data.frame() %>%

    Dx = names(sort(table(Dx), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    Path.Stage.bin = names(sort(table(Path.Stage.bin), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("orig.merge")

pheatmap(markers.top, show_colnames = FALSE, show_rownames = T, annotation_col = anno_df)
